capabilities: Fuzzy-search ayahs by Arabic text, surah name, or reference number
Insert ayahs, full surahs, or mushaf pages as callout, blockquote, or inline text
Create standalone ayah notes with customizable name patterns and tags
Configure default insert format and callout type in settings
extras: README is bilingual (Arabic and English) with screenshot placeholders; text data comes from the bundled QPC Hafs script by QUL/TarteelAL, so no internet connection is needed.
intentEvidence: الاختلاف عن إضافة Obsidian Quran Lookup Plugin
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up and insert Quran verses, and the existing lookup plugin requires internet and exact Surah:Ayah formatting.

relations.evidence: الاختلاف عن إضافة Obsidian Quran Lookup Plugin - هذه الإضافة لا تتطلب تنسيق Surah:Ayah
